name: Lord Spriggan
description: The sovereign lord of the Spriggan lineage. Lord Spriggan commands the battlefield with divine authority — its dual-spin mastery and golden crown layer make it an unbreakable force that adapts to any threat.

ability.name: Lord's Decree
ability.description: Lord Spriggan issues a royal decree — adapting perfectly to the enemy type. vs Attack: 55 HP shield + reflect 20 true dmg. vs Defense/Stamina: +40 ATK for 3 turns + silence for 1 turn. All modes grant permanent +15 ATK after activation and the next attack pierces defense.

chain._note: Lord's Decree: +15 ATK permanently after first Special

special_move.name: Lord's Judgement
special_move.description: Lord Spriggan delivers a royal four-hit verdict — each strike infused with sovereign authority!
flavour_texts: 🌀 **Strike 4** — LORD'S JUDGEMENT — BY ROYAL DECREE, ANNIHILATION!
